title: Label-Free Mass Spectrometry Proteomics Reveals Different Pathways Modulated in THP‐1 Cells Infected with Therapeutic Failure and Drug Resistance Leishmania infantum Clinical Isolates
body:
##  [ Label-Free Mass Spectrometry Proteomics Reveals Different Pathways Modulated in THP‐1 Cells Infected with Therapeutic Failure and Drug Resistance Leishmania infantum Clinical Isolates ](</content/reactome-research-spotlight/226-label-free-mass-spectrometry-proteomics-reveals-different-pathways-modulated-in-thp-1-cells-infected-with-therapeutic-failure-and-drug-resistance-leishmania-infantum-clinical-isolates>)

[Tagliazucchi L et al. 2023 in the March 2023 issue of ACS Infectious Diseases ](<https://pubs.acs.org/doi/pdf/10.1021/acsinfecdis.2c00457>)used the REACTOME overrepresentation and pathway topology analyses to identify [Transport of small molecules](</PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-382551>), [Cellular response to stress](</PathwayBrowser/#/2262752&PATH=R-HSA-8953897>) and other pathways associated with drug resistance and therapeutic failure (TF) during _Leishmania infantum_ infection; they also discovered NDK3 and TFRC as potential targets for host-directed anti-Leishmania therapies to overcome drug-resistance.
